verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a SaaS corporate-banking and card platform with an API, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers cards, VCNs, statements, OAuth scopes and docs formats, but nothing mentions telemetry, analytics or tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
